desc:
🎯 Steal an egg before the pets catch you!
🐣 Hatch eggs on your plot to collect rare pets — upgrade them and they'll earn you cash!
🌤 Use your cash to grow your Beanstalk and climb to new areas!
⬆ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🧠 Capture new pets to grow your collection!
👍 Like, favorite and follow if you enjoyed the game!
